case_name: Smti. Joycee Chyne vs . Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited & Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smti. Joycee Chyne, second wife of the deceased

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the second wife of the deceased who had contracted marriage with her during subsistence of his first marriage. Notice to respondent No.4 was not issued. Sanction for family pension in favour of the petitioner has been declined.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnized in contravention to the condition that 'neither party has a spouse living' is void.
legal_principles.held: In terms of Section 4 of the Act of 1954, requirement of faith is not a condition. Irrespective of any faith, marriage can be solemnized subject to the condition as incorporated in Section 4 which includes 'neither party has a spouse living'.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnized under the Special Marriage Act, 1954 is controlled by the condition that 'neither party has a spouse living'.
legal_principles.held: Such an argument is of no help to the petitioner. In terms of Section 4 of the Act of 1954, solemnization of marriage between two persons under the Act is also controlled by important condition i.e. 'neither party has a spouse living'.

outcome.final_order: The respondents are directed to process the family pension case in favour of the petitioner as she is entitled to receive monthly pension after the death of her husband.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for family pension
